# COVR — llms.txt
# https://www.covrcases.com

## About
COVR is Ireland's first automated phone case printing kiosk company.
We operate UV printing kiosks in premium Dublin shopping centres.

## Product
- Custom phone cases are printed in under 3 minutes from any personal photo
- Standard cases: €25
- MagSafe magnetic cases: €30
- Payment: card or contactless at the kiosk
- No app download required

## Compatible Phone Models
- iPhone 14, 15, 16, 16 Pro, 17
- Samsung Galaxy S23, S24, S25
- Google Pixel 7, 8, 9

## How It Works
1. Scan the QR code on the kiosk with your phone camera
2. Upload a photo from your camera roll or Instagram
3. Select your phone model, adjust the design, pay by card
4. Collect your printed case from the dispenser in under 3 minutes

## Print Technology
UV-cured ink bonded directly to the case — vivid, scratch-resistant, built to last.
Not a sticker. Not a paper sleeve.

## Launch
Launching May 2026 at a premium Dublin shopping centre.
Join the waitlist at https://www.covrcases.com for exclusive launch-week pricing.
